confirmed_user_decisions.acceptance_scope: Complete engineering delivery, separate physical validation gate
confirmed_user_decisions.architecture_constraints: 7R/18 actuators are candidates; specific alternatives require user alignment
confirmed_user_decisions.budget: No hard ceiling; expectation tens of thousands RMB; avoid extravagant or obscure components; material included; printer excluded
confirmed_user_decisions.printer_recommendation_requested: Current Bambu Lab machine suitable for Goose engineering
confirmed_user_decisions.first_release_use_case: Indoor level ground walking, turning, stopping; ground/low tabletop specified 50 g object pickup and release; stairs/outdoors later
confirmed_user_decisions.scale_priority: Long-neck goose proportions, compact and lightweight; size derived from actual parts, load and reach
confirmed_user_decisions.required_neck_head_motions: Reach/retract, ground lowering, left/right looking, pitch and sideways grasp; independent middle twist/head yaw not mandatory before comparison
confirmed_user_decisions.dragging_priority: Dragging is a first-release core function equally important as pickup, superseding prior suggestion to defer towing
confirmed_user_decisions.design_inspiration: Untitled Goose Game humorous and practical physical interaction; actual dragging gameplay video research requested
confirmed_user_decisions.drag_object_and_surface_envelope: Specified lightweight everyday objects: cloth edge, empty slipper, light basket/box; wheeled trolley supplementary; indoor level hard floor
confirmed_user_decisions.operation_and_autonomy_scope: Teleoperation plus autonomous specified-object pickup/bring/drag-to-location/release; general household recognition and free exploration later
confirmed_user_decisions.honk_and_behavior_scope: Honk with head/neck/beak expression is first-release core; no wing actuators
confirmed_user_decisions.appearance_direction: May move closer to Untitled Goose Game appearance if engineering feasibility is preserved; no extra wing actuators
confirmed_user_decisions.side_wings: Two manual-opening wing-shaped inspection/service doors; no wing actuators; hinge/retention/open envelope to be designed
confirmed_user_decisions.side_wing_styling: Minimal abstract side panels using clean surfaces, proportions and restrained seams; no literal wing outline or detailed feathers
confirmed_user_decisions.autonomous_continuation_authority: User going to sleep; remaining structure/component/implementation decisions delegated to agent judgment. Preserve confirmed goals, record rationale; no further routine approval gate.
